item.description: Broadcasting from Ramey Motors in Purvis, Mississippi: The guys recap last night’s USM basketball matchups. William Carey University head basketball coach Steve Knight. Plus, Dakota Baker from Ramey Motors joins Bob, Kelly, and Dima.

item.title: House passes bill to reimburse Mississippi National Guard members for health care costs
item.description: The Mississippi House of Representatives passed a bill Thursday that would reimburse eligible National Guard members for the cost of individual health and dental insurance premiums. HB 1085, authored by House Military Affairs Committee Chair Bubba Carpenter, R-Burnsville, passed 121–0 and would establish the Mississippi National Guard TRICARE Premium Reimbursement Program, which would cover premiums […]

item.title: Thunder & Lightning: Running The Trade Machine for Mississippi State Football
item.description: Thursday saw the NBA Trade Deadline come and go, and it makes you wonder, what if you could make trades in College Football? Brian Hadad and Robbie Faulk play the role of general manager, and try to construct some real trades that could benefit Mississippi State but be somewhat realistic at the same time.
